subject: LODMI | raw rank202

evidence.finding: LODMI states it operates charging points for its clients, with access, management and billing remotely controlled through MOBIGEST.
LODMI app exposes connector/power/tarification in real time before charge and supports remote session start.
Client-host operation plus real-time station tariff semantics do not support a single national LODMI direct tariff.

decision: active->setAside; CPO authority proven but client/site-configurable real-time tariff model and no deterministic anonymous station/EVSE -> current direct tariff resolver recovered
reopenCondition: Supported LODMI/MOBIGEST guest endpoint or exact QR/ad-hoc tariff payload mapped to historical/current LODMI EVSE.
fallback: Electra then Electroverse only as roaming fallback where compatible
next: TANAY Electricité raw203; then LMS Informatique raw204.
